official_statement_rationale: While I maintain my vote for a status quo on the repo rate, I dissent on the stance of 'withdrawal of accommodation'. With core inflation at a benign 3.10%, the real policy rate is already sufficiently restrictive to anchor expectations. Monetary policy is a blunt instrument for supply-side food price shocks, which currently drive the headline CPI of 4.75%. Given the positive output gap is only marginal at 0.40% and GVA growth is at 6.80%, continuing to signal a withdrawal of accommodation risks over-tightening and unnecessarily constraining the ongoing recovery. A shift to a neutral stance is warranted to better reflect the current macroeconomic reality and provide the MPC with the necessary flexibility to respond to incoming data without signaling an overly hawkish bias that may dampen private investment.
